source.adaptation: Deluno's guided layer over the pinned TRaSH Guides revision. Every entry that names a TRaSH format carries that format's exact id, name and conditions from the pinned source inventory, per media type; Deluno adds only the friendly grouping, the plain-language description and the reviewed typed meaning. Formats TRaSH does not publish are Deluno-owned extras with deluno- ids. Unreviewed upstream formats stay Advanced. This package is not a Recyclarr export.

qualityProfiles.name: 1080p Streaming
qualityProfiles.description: The most popular choice. Grabs WEB-DL 1080p releases from Netflix, Amazon, Apple TV+ and other streaming services. Perfect balance of quality and storage.

qualityProfiles.name: 1080p HD Blu-ray + WEB
qualityProfiles.description: Starts with WEB-DL 1080p, then automatically upgrades to Blu-ray 1080p when available. Recommended for cinephiles who want the best 1080p experience.

qualityProfiles.name: 4K Streaming
qualityProfiles.description: Grabs WEB-DL 4K (2160p) releases from Netflix, Amazon, Apple TV+ and others. Includes HDR content. Perfect for 4K displays without needing massive Remux files.

qualityProfiles.name: 4K Remux
qualityProfiles.description: The absolute best quality — a bit-for-bit copy of the 4K Blu-ray disc. Largest file sizes but perfect video and audio with all HDR formats and lossless audio.
highlights: All HDR formats: DV, HDR10+, HDR10

qualityProfiles.name: TV — 1080p Streaming
qualityProfiles.description: The recommended profile for TV shows. Grabs WEB-DL 1080p from streaming platforms. Same day as Netflix, Amazon, etc.

qualityProfiles.name: Anime — 1080p Remux
qualityProfiles.description: Optimised for anime releases. Prefers Blu-ray Remux sources from trusted anime groups. Supports both dual audio and Japanese audio with subtitles.
highlights: Blu-ray Remux from trusted anime groups

bundles.name: Simple 1080p Streaming
bundles.description: A safe default for most users. Prefer clean WEB releases, block obvious bad releases, and avoid fragile HDR rules.
bundles.bestFor: First setup, small libraries, families, laptops, and users who just want reliable 1080p playback.

bundles.name: Balanced 1080p
bundles.description: A better everyday profile with sensible audio, trusted WEB groups, and common bad-release blocking.
bundles.bestFor: Main libraries where quality matters but storage should not explode.

bundles.name: Premium 4K Streaming
bundles.description: Prioritises 2160p WEB releases, HDR, good audio, and clean source tags without forcing full remux sizes.
bundles.bestFor: 4K televisions, Apple TV / Shield / Plex users, and users who want a premium library without huge files.
warnings: Dolby Vision is boosted. If your display does not support it, keep the no-fallback blocker enabled.

bundles.name: Archive 4K Remux
bundles.description: Large-file movie archive preset. Prefers remux, UHD Blu-ray groups, lossless audio, HDR, and special editions.
bundles.bestFor: Reference movie libraries, home cinema rooms, and users who care more about quality than disk usage.
warnings: This can create very large files. Pair it with a dedicated movie root or storage policy.

bundles.name: Anime Balanced
bundles.description: Anime-specific release groups, dual-audio preference, uncensored boost, and raw-release blocking.
bundles.bestFor: Anime libraries where normal Sonarr-style scoring is not enough.

bundles.name: Storage Saver
bundles.description: Keeps quality sane while discouraging remux-sized and very high bitrate releases.
bundles.bestFor: NAS storage limits, remote users, slower upload links, or libraries with many users.
